parts.name: Tooltip
parts.description: A box near the point under the pointer, or near the point that has the keyboard focus.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content. It receives the point, and the x and y values as text. Without it, the tooltip
shows the x value, the series and the y value.

props.name: offset
props.description: The distance between the point and the tooltip, in pixels. The default is 8.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the tooltip.

dataAttributes.name: data-series
dataAttributes.description: On the box. The value is the name of the series of the point.

dataAttributes.name: data-tooltip-key
dataAttributes.description: On the line with the category or the x value.

dataAttributes.name: data-tooltip-value
dataAttributes.description: On the line with the series and the value.

dataAttributes.name: data-tooltip-series
dataAttributes.description: On the name of the series.

parts.name: ChartTooltipState
parts.description: The value that the children snippet receives.

props.name: x
props.description: The position of the point in the plot, in pixels.

props.name: horizontal
props.description:
Whether the categories of the mark are on the y axis, as in a horizontal bar chart. Then
`yText` names the category and `xText` is the value.
